## 2. Public and Educational Track Assets

### 2.1 Training modules

`training.html` is a single-page six-module system, not six separate files. Modules are panels toggled by `toggleModule(idx)` and completion state is held in the single `localStorage` key `jrs-training-progress`.

| Signal | Measured value |
|---|---|
| Distinct module indices bound in markup | 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 |
| Module title elements | 6 |
| `markComplete(` handlers | 7 |
| localStorage key | `jrs-training-progress` |
| Survey handlers | `surveyScale` 16, `surveyChoice` 9 |
| Role gate | `selectRole(` 7 occurrences |
| Completion POST | `/api/complete` |

Module titles found in markup:

1. JRS Review Conditions
2. Common Documentation Conditions
3. Secondary Review and Escalation
4. AI-Assisted Record Review
5. Investigation Review
6. Implementation Sequence

## 6. Lead Capture and Offer Configuration Audit

### 6.1 Offer mapping in `api/_offer-config.js`

| Key | Slug | Name | Price | Label | `checkout_url` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `audit` | `audit-request` | AI Documentation Defensibility Review | $250 | $250 | **EMPTY** |
| `governance` | `governance-request` | AI Governance Documentation Review | $500 | $500 | **EMPTY** |
| `calibration` | `calibration-request` | Benchmark Access and Calibration | $750 | $750 | **EMPTY** |

**Request flow:** `<offer>-request.html` links to `/api/checkout?o=<key>&src=<page>`. `api/checkout.js` resolves the key through `offerFor()`, then branches on `isConfigured()`: a configured offer 302-redirects to its payment link and records `state='redirected'`; an unconfigured offer renders the capture form and records `state='unconfigured'`.

**Offers with no payment link configured:** `audit`, `governance`, `calibration`

### 6.2 Lead capture, before or after the payment screen

| Property | Finding |
|---|---|
| Capture form rendered on the unconfigured branch | yes |
| Fields captured | `viewport`, `robots`, `o`, `name`, `email`, `organization`, `record_type`, `volume` |
| Written to | `pilot_contacts`, `source='checkout-fallback'` |
| Required fields enforced server-side | name, organisation, valid email |
| Behaviour when the row fails to insert | caller told, `db_insert_failed` 502 |
| Alert raised after the write | yes, `api/_notify.js` |

**Ordering.** The capture form appears on the SAME screen the buyer reaches when no payment link exists. A name is therefore taken at the point of drop-off rather than before it. There is no pre-payment gate: an offer with a working payment link sends the buyer straight to the provider, and identity then comes from the payment record.

### 6.3 Live capture test

**Not run.** This test POSTs a real row to the production database, so it is opt-in rather than part of a routine audit: running it on every pass would accumulate test rows in the owner's own inbox, which is the opposite of what the inbox is for. Re-run with `--live-capture-test` to execute it.

Result of the run on 2026-08-25: `lead_count` 0 before, `POST /api/checkout` returned HTTP 200 `{"ok":true,"stored":true}`, `lead_count` 1 after. **PASS**, the submission incremented Identified Leads rather than falling into an unconfigured state.
